priorityList: Use Algethar Puzzle Box and Aimed Shot during the pre-combat window.
Cast Black Arrow as your top priority whenever it is available.
Cast Multi-Shot if the Trick Shots buff is not active or if you have the Precise Shots buff.
Activate Trueshot on cooldown as your primary offensive window.
Use Volley on cooldown to immediately grant the Trick Shots buff.
Cast Aimed Shot only while the Trick Shots buff is active to ensure it hits multiple targets.
Cast Rapid Fire while the Trick Shots buff is active, prioritizing it if the Bulletstorm buff is about to expire or the target is below 20% health.
Use offensive racial abilities (such as Berserking, Blood Fury, or Fireblood) and combat Potions while Trueshot is active.
Use Steady Shot as a filler to generate Focus when no other abilities are available.
